newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends down in kerb, seen volatile.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends down in kerb, seen volatile.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.03 rupees down at 42.03 to the dollar on Wednesday in the kerb market amid a rise in dollar demand ahead of a court verdict on the dismissal of Benazir Bhutto, dealers said.
They said the rupee would be volatile on Thursday depending on the repercussions of the Supreme Court verdict, expected later on Wednesday, on whether Bhutto should be restored.

The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar. The premium on forex bearer certificates closed at 5.05 percent, from Tuesday's close at 5.0 percent. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
